abstract: At order $21$, a minimum $10$-chromatic biplanar graph $G$ is $10$-critical with $\alpha(G)=3$, $\omega(G)\le 8$, $\delta(G)\ge 9$, and $|E(G)|=114-\eta$. In the three-disjoint-triple ($t=18$) branch, where $G-S$ is $9$-vertex-critical for every independent triple $S$ and $X=S_1\sqcup S_2\sqcup S_3$ ($|S_i|=3$) leaves a $12$-vertex core $C=G-X$ with $\chi(C)\in\{7,8\}$, we prove $42-e(C)=\eta+\sum_{x\in X}\varepsilon_x+B_\triangle$, establish the slack ceilings $3\eta+\sum_{x\in X}\varepsilon_x+B_\triangle\le 42-e(G[X])\le 33$ and $3e(C)+e(X,C)\ge 144$, and classify all $11{,}142{,}487$ tripartite graphs $G[X]$ with $\alpha(G[X])\le 3$ into $9{,}654$ order-$1296$ orbits. Using a Color-Class Multiplicity Identity, Single-Vertex Kempe Forced-Bit pruning, a Two-Part $K_7$-Free Core Closure Theorem ($\chi(C)=7,\omega(C)\le 6,e(C)\le 42$), Hall SDR bounds, and an $\operatorname{Aut}(G[X],d_G)$-reduced Core Independent-Triple Degree Lemma on `Rep 12`, we verify zero biplanar survivors across all $29$ balanced orbits ($B\in\{0,1\}$ complete and $18$ $s_{\min}=0,B=2$ orbits across $\eta\ge 0$) and across **all $39/39$ $K_7$-free $\chi(C)=7$ orbits** and **all $39/39$ $\chi(C)=8$ ($K_8\subseteq C$) orbits** on the unbalanced $(0,0,1)$ boundary ($B_\triangle=1,e(C)\le 41$). Finally, we show that our $6$ pre-Euler survivors at $t=2,B=1$ contain the $16$-vertex $9$-critical core $H_{16}=K_1\vee C_5[2,5,1,6,1]$, construct an Euler-complete $23$-vertex, $124$-edge, $10$-edge-critical split repair $G_{23}^*$, and prove three purely analytical (zero-computer) non-biplanarity theorems—the $K_9-e$ Bridge Lemma, the $17$-vertex Hajós merge $M_{17}$, and a wheel-rim contradiction on $(K_7-e)\vee C_5$—refuting $G_{23}^*$ and all $G_{21+s}^*$ ($0\le s\le 5$).
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Completes 100% (39/39) closure of the first-slack unbalanced (0, 0, 1) boundary orbits for chi(C) = 8 (K_8 subseteq C) and proves three purely analytical (zero-computer) non-biplanarity theorems resolving the biplanarity of G_23^*, all G_{21+s}^* (0 <= s <= 5), and the single-end join G_12 = (K_7 - e) v C_5: (1) Complete 39/39 (0, 0, 1) chi(C) = 8 Closure (Section 5.4, Table 2, and src/verify_rep12_chi8.py): Resolved the sole remaining orbit Rep 12 = (85, 227, 227) (Orbit #13, 1-based) in 16.5s by exploiting its exact disconnected decomposition G[X] = T sqcup O (where T = {1, 4, 8} is an isolated triangle of degree-9 vertices and O = {0, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7} ~= K_{2,2,2} - e is an octahedron minus one edge of degree-10 vertices, |Aut(G[X], d_G)| = 24), reducing 3,112,694 unreduced multisets to 780,893 Aut-canonical multisets and 161,976 degree survivors, and proving the Core Independent-Triple Degree Lemma (no independent triple S subseteq C can contain >= 2 neighbors of x in T or >= 3 neighbors of x in O), lossless color-sharing dirty-bit masks on R_4 x K_8, and 64-bit packed q_0-hoisted supermask pruning (2,378,539 splits -> 162,140 degree survivors -> 27 m_3-survivors -> 0 full survivors). (2) Three Analytical Non-Biplanarity Theorems (Theorem 5(2-4), Section 6.3, and src/verify_g23_and_cofaciality.py): Proved the 2-line K_9 - e Bridge Lemma (in any biplanar decomposition of K_9 - (v_1, v_2), v_1 and v_2 are connected in both planar layers because a bridge cannot belong to any 2-edge-connected Kuratowski subgraph K_5 or K_{3,3}), which proves cut-connectivity of K_{10} - (K_{1,s} sqcup K_2) for all 1 <= s <= 8 without computer search; identified the 17-vertex, 71-edge Hajos merge M_17 = (V^(1) \ {20}) cup (V^(3) \ {0}) subseteq G_23^* of A = K_9 - (1, 19) and B = K_9 - (6, 19) meeting at {19} and linked by (1, 6), proving analytically that G_23^* and all G_{21+s}^* (0 <= s <= 5) are non-biplanar (removing the open-problem caveat from v2); and proved the Wheel-Rim Contradiction (5 = |E(C_5)| >= 3 + 3 = 6) refuting the 12-vertex, 60-edge single-end join G_12 = (K_7 - e) v C_5. (3) Second-Slack Boundary Census & Precision Updates (Table 1 and src/enumerate_t18_gx_orbits.py): Added exact verification of the second-slack (e(C) = 40) boundary census ((2,0): 75,816 records / 78 orbits; (1,1): 548,532 records / 454 orbits; (0,2): 450,522 records / 398 orbits) and addressed all minor precision notes from the v2 referee report.
title: Color-Class Multiplicity, Two-Part K7-Free Core Elimination, Complete First-Slack (0,0,1) K8 Closure, and Analytical Refutation of the Order-23 Euler-Complete Split Obstruction
